title: Goals
description: The goal layer's typed goals (Plan 23 Task 13, spec section 8, P23-10): a goal source proposes one of these, the runner validates it (planner/goals.validate) and runs it under the instincts; each object's properties other than type are its dataclass's fields in planner/goals.py (P23-B).

strategy.text: Prefer the nearest building listed without L over farther ones, and loot a building until it reads L before the next; while night is true return to cleared ground (a building listed v or L), and explore new ground by day.

Want water and a vessel first (inventory_by_use water and container), then a weapon while weapon is null, then clothing with bite defence (shoes, a jacket, a hat: a higher bite in worn), then food, then bandages.
With tired true or needs.fatigue near it, or late in the day (night true, or the hour close to it), choose Shelter in a listed building over a LootBuilding.
Avoid a building listed with zombies beside it (z: above 0) and one whose way from pos crosses met.dense; prefer a building whose door faces away from them.
Keep the load light: load.level below 1, the first heavy-load level, before going to a building listed with zombies beside it (z: above 0).
